To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed hybrid approach can automatically identify dataset attributes from MEDLINE abstracts with high precision and recall, and can improve the search performance of literature with desired datasets by using the identified dataset attributes.

We developed a hybrid approach to automatically recognize GWAS dataset attributes from MEDLINE abstracts; We built an online GWAs dataset search engine, called the GWAS Dataset Searcher, to retrieve GWAS dataset-related literature; The GWAS Dataset Search Engine outperforms PubMed significantly in retrieving desired GWAS dataset literature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a text mining approach to identify data set attributes in scientific literature, and building a search engine to retrieve scientific literature with desired datasets.
developing a scalable approach for identifying data sets mentioned in scientific literature and linking them to their corresponding publications.
the problem of identifying and linking data sets in the literature.

our work demonstrates the potential application in text mining methods in the development of a data discovery index that can link literature with their underlying data.
the study demonstrates a promising approach to automatically identify and index data sets in scientific literature, and the resulting data set discovery index can be used to improve data re-use.
the proposed approach is a promising way to automatically extract and index data sets from literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a scalable approach that automatically scans millions of scientific literature and identifies underlying data sets.
the GWAS dataset search system can help researchers to find GWAS datasets in MEDLINE abstract, and thus can be used as a starting point to find more relevant data sets.

(1) we developed a hybrid approach for identifying GWAS dataset attributes from MEDLINE abstracts with an F-measure 84.85%; (2) the hybrid approach was used to index MEDLINE abstracts; (3) the GWAS Dataset Attribute Index (DAI) was used to build a GWAS dataset search interface, called “GWAS dataset finder” (GDF), to retrieve relevant literature for GWAS datasets.

the text mining methods can be used as an effective tool to build data discovery indices.
we can leverage existing text mining methods to build a better index of data in literature.
